The missing-file failure occurred before native decoding and before selected-analysis reservation. The new offline version used the original unused allowance, carried failure clock, kept acquisition closed, and performed the first actual native selection. No source or artifact target was retried.

The separately declared exploratory timing method was rejected by its prospective scalar budget check before table parsing or any additional native field decode. It produced no bracket or profile result; do not lower allowances/retry it to fit.

The final177160 upper bound is retained accounting for work admitted before the prospective rejection, not proof that the proposed additional work fit the250000 cap. No source budget or time reset was used.

Sampling-domain depths, near-bed instrument placement, temperature layer definitions and transport integration limits are not complete current depths. No pressure conversion, inferred current bottom, thickness, annual range or volume is admitted.
